brief.title: Sunside
brief.premise: A salvage rigger at a solar-sail shipyard inside Mercury's orbit finds a hull logged as scrapped still drawing power, and must prove it before the yard's charter auditors arrive.
constraints: No faster-than-light travel or communication; everything obeys orbital mechanics.

world.name: Perihelion Yard
world.description: A sail shipyard in a sun-grazing orbit inside Mercury's, where crews re-mirror sails under brutal heat budgets, and every gram of salvage is owed to the mass ledger.

locations.name: The Yard Spine
locations.description: The kilometre-long gantry truss where sail hulls are berthed and re-mirrored.

locations.name: The Mirror Shed
locations.description: A shadowed workshop where crews re-silver sail film under vacuum.

locations.name: The Bastion Hulk
locations.description: The radiation-shielded command module where the yard office and audit berth sit.

locations.name: Shadow Dock
locations.description: A dry dock permanently eclipsed behind the yard's own truss, invisible to thermal survey.

factions.name: The Riggers' Union
factions.description: The perihelion riggers' union, which holds the heat rosters and the safety charter.

factions.name: The Charter Audit Office
factions.description: Auditors with a permanent berth at the Bastion Hulk, empowered to seize the mass ledger.

factions.name: The Helio Tank Consortium
factions.description: The owners' consortium that charters the yard and buys every scrapped hull.

rules.statement: A tight-beam reply from the inner system takes at least ten minutes; nobody gets an instant answer.
No crew may work sunside longer than their logged heat budget allows; the duty log is law.
Every gram that leaves the yard is entered in the mass ledger; unlogged salvage is theft.
Shadow Dock never sees the sun; anything berthed there does not register on thermal survey.

history.name: The Keel Year
history.description: The yard truss was assembled from cannibalised tankers to service the inner-system sail fleet.

history.name: The Sail Fire
history.description: A mis-folded sail focused the sun onto a dock crew; the safety charter was rewritten in its wake.

history.name: The Audit Charter
history.description: The owners granted the audit office a permanent berth after a season of ledger fraud.

conflicts.name: The Scrap Ledger
conflicts.description: The union suspects hulls logged as scrapped are being kept as spares in Shadow Dock, off the mass ledger.

conflicts.name: The Heat Roster
conflicts.description: Helio Tank wants longer sunside shifts than the union's heat budget allows.

characters.name: Ria Callum
characters.description: A salvage rigger with ten perihelion seasons on the Spine, who trusts torque wrenches and duty logs more than offices.
characters.motivation: To prove the scrapped hull is real before the auditors can bury it.
characters.goal: Document the ghost hull's power draw and get it on the record.
characters.flaw: She hoards evidence instead of trusting anyone with it.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants justice but fears what it will cost her crewmates' berths.
characters.external_conflict: The audit office can classify her evidence and her along with it.

abilities.name: Load-path reading
abilities.description: Traces power and load draws through a hull's conduit plan by inspection.

characters.arc: Ria learns to put the evidence in other people's hands before it can be silenced.

characters.name: Director Savane
characters.description: The audit director who certified the ghost hull's scrap certificate and controls what the charter sees.
characters.motivation: To close the merger before the spare hull is discovered on the books.
characters.goal: Keep the Shadow Dock berth unlogged until the merger seals.
characters.flaw: He believes procedure shields him from arithmetic.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows the hull is irregular but has convinced himself it is necessary.
characters.external_conflict: Ria's measurements put the lie in his own ledger.

abilities.name: Ledger forensics
abilities.description: Finds and hides discrepancies inside mass ledgers better than anyone in the audit office.

characters.arc: Savane's own charter turns on him when the numbers are read aloud.

characters.name: Bex Osei
characters.description: The Mirror Shed forewoman who re-silvers sail film and guards her crew's heat budget like blood.
characters.motivation: To keep her crew under budget and out of the audit's way.
characters.goal: Verify the mass-ledger gap without burning her crew's exposure.
characters.flaw: She shields her people so hard they never see the whole truth.
characters.internal_conflict: Helping Ria means endangering the crew she protects.
characters.external_conflict: The audit can pull her crew's heat budget if she cooperates.

abilities.name: Film-welding
abilities.description: Splices and re-silvers torn sail film in vacuum under a strict time budget.

characters.arc: Bex stops protecting her crew from the truth and lets them choose it.

relationships.description: Bex is the only forewoman Ria trusts with the ledger gap.
relationships.conflict: Bex wants it handled quietly; Ria wants it on the record.

relationships.description: Savane audited the scrap certificate Ria is disproving.
relationships.conflict: Each controls a different copy of the truth.

evidence_summary: The world, cast and storyboard satisfy the brief's orbital-mechanics shipyard setting; deterministic validators are clean and there are no blocking defects.
